cover_correction.formula: delta(g)_i = (weight(row_i(g))-1)/2 mod 2; apply X_delta(g) to EVERY final live stream in cover class g.
cover_correction.reason: P_g C_all P_g^-1 = C_all X_delta(g) exactly. Orthogonality cancels all quadratic cross terms; both sides fix the uniform vector.

global_phase_argument: Every C_q and every linear address permutation fixes the uniform vector. Equality of the exact Z4 Fourier multiplier therefore fixes the scalar phase as well.
scope: All compressed data boundary operators, idle children, terminal X_q and all-live cover correction. Internal arbitrary-subspace canonical labels are checked separately.
